from common import *
import shutil

def main():
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    from backtest.models import regime_adapt as models
    harness('check');save_source(__file__)
    if PROGRESS.exists():
        check(read(PROGRESS)['prepared_inputs']);print('reuse prepared',STAGE);return
    for subdir in ['configs','docs','data','metrics','reports','source-records']:
        (BASE/subdir).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    lab=pd.read_csv(REGIME,parse_dates=['datetime','ready_date']).set_index('datetime')
    assert lab.index.is_unique and lab.index.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert set(lab.style4.dropna())==set(STYLES)
    assert lab.style4.notna().equals(lab.ready_date.notna())
    y=pd.read_pickle(TARGET);assert y.index.is_unique and y.notna().all() and y.index.names==['datetime','instrument']
    calendar=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime((PROVIDER/'calendars/day.txt').read_text().splitlines()))
    t=pd.DatetimeIndex(y.index.get_level_values('datetime'))
    unique=pd.DatetimeIndex(t.unique()).sort_values()
    pos=calendar.get_indexer(unique);assert (pos>=0).all()
    boundary=pd.Timestamp('2020-07-31');label=lab.reindex(unique)
    exits=calendar[pos+6]
    counts=pd.Series(1,index=t).groupby(level=0).sum().reindex(unique)
    decisions=pd.DataFrame({'style4':label.style4,'ready':label.ready_date,'target_exit':exits,'stock_rows':counts},index=unique)
    decisions['membership_known']=decisions.ready.notna()&decisions.ready.le(boundary)
    decisions['target_exited']=decisions.target_exit.le(boundary)
    decisions['retained']=decisions.membership_known&decisions.target_exited
    assert decisions.loc[decisions.retained,'style4'].notna().all()
    def census(mask):return {'dates':int(mask.sum()),'rows':int(decisions.stock_rows[mask].sum())}
    des={'original':{'rows':len(y),'dates':len(unique)},'missing_membership':census(decisions.style4.isna()),
         'membership_ready_after_cutoff_or_missing':census(~decisions.membership_known),
         'stock_target_exit_after_cutoff':census(~decisions.target_exited),
         'excluded_by_both':census(~decisions.membership_known&~decisions.target_exited),
         'removed_by_target_after_membership_filter':census(decisions.membership_known&~decisions.target_exited),
         'retained':census(decisions.retained),'retained_by_style':{v:census(decisions.retained&decisions.style4.eq(v)) for v in STYLES}}
    target_evidence=read(TARGET_AUDIT)['h5']
    assert (des['retained']['rows'],des['retained']['dates'])==(target_evidence['cutoff_rows'],target_evidence['cutoff_dates'])
    assert set(np.unique(y.to_numpy()))==set(target_evidence['scores_float32'])
    decisions.to_csv(BASE/'data/train-date-eligibility.csv',index_label='datetime')
    write(BASE/'docs/train-boundary-audit.json',des)
    evaldays=calendar[(calendar>='2020-08-03')&(calendar<='2026-07-23')]
    assert len(evaldays)==1448
    es=lab.reindex(evaldays);assert es.style4.notna().all() and es.ready_date.notna().all()
    good=decisions[decisions.retained];styles=decisions.style4.reindex(t)
    included=t.isin(good.index)
    prep={k:read(OLD/'configs/prepared-inputs.json')[k] for k in ['data_version','frozen_market_inventory','baseline_manifest','feature_manifest','validation_manifest','day_weights','frozen_st']}
    prep.update(training_target=fingerprint(TARGET),target_audit=fingerprint(TARGET_AUDIT),granularity=STAGE,eval_regime=fingerprint(REGIME),subsets={},eligible_train_rows=des['retained']['rows'],
                eligible_train_dates=des['retained']['dates'],eval_day_counts={**es.style4.value_counts().to_dict(),'ALL':len(es)},
                train_day_counts={**good.style4.value_counts().to_dict(),'ALL':len(good)},train_boundary=fingerprint(BASE/'docs/train-boundary-audit.json'),
                train_date_eligibility=fingerprint(BASE/'data/train-date-eligibility.csv'),eval_four_label_counts=es.style4.value_counts().to_dict())
    for v in VARIANTS:
        sub=y.iloc[np.flatnonzero(included if v=='ALL' else included&styles.eq(v).to_numpy())]
        assert len(sub)>0 and len(sub)==(des['retained']['rows'] if v=='ALL' else des['retained_by_style'][v]['rows'])
        subsetpath=BASE/'data'/f'target-{v}.pkl';sub.to_pickle(subsetpath)
        w=models.compose_day_weights(sub.index,pd.Series(np.ones(len(sub))),models.load_day_weights(str(WEIGHTS)))
        dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(sub.index.get_level_values('datetime').unique())
        prep['subsets'][v]={'rows':len(sub),'row_share':len(sub)/prep['eligible_train_rows'],'dates':len(dates),
            'start':str(dates.min().date()),'end':str(dates.max().date()),'target':fingerprint(subsetpath),
            'label_sha256':hash_array(sub.to_numpy()),'weight_sha256':hash_array(w.to_numpy())}
    assert sum(prep['subsets'][v]['rows'] for v in STYLES)==prep['eligible_train_rows']
    write(STAGE_INPUTS,prep)
    shutil.copy2(OLD/'configs/evaluation.yaml',BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml')
    write(PROGRESS,{'status':'prepared','granularity':STAGE,'prepared_inputs':fingerprint(STAGE_INPUTS),
                    'jobs':[],'scientific_candidates':{v:{'status':'planned'} for v in EVALUATIONS}})
    harness('event',{'type':'freeze','paths':[str(x) for x in [STAGE_INPUTS,BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml',BASE/'docs/train-boundary-audit.json',BASE/'data/train-date-eligibility.csv',*[BASE/'data'/f'target-{v}.pkl' for v in VARIANTS]]]})
    harness('event',{'type':'stage_status','values':{'status':'prepared'}})
    print(STAGE,des,'score_days',prep['eval_day_counts'],flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
